name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for a glass wall installation quote?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for a glass wall installation quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting us, it's helpful to have an idea of the intended location and purpose of the glass wall, along with any preliminary measurements of the area. Considering your aesthetic preferences, such as frameless or framed, and any desired features like doors or privacy treatments (e.g., frosting), will also streamline the consultation. If possible, gather photos of the space and any inspiration images. This preparation helps us understand your vision and provide a more accurate and tailored quote, ensuring we address all your specific requirements from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare the intended location, purpose, preliminary measurements, aesthetic preferences, and desired features like doors or privacy. Photos of the space and inspiration images are also helpful.
